evidence.description: Direct access to the User.shared singleton.

candidates.explanation: The component directly accesses the 'User.shared' singleton to retrieve the analytics ID, creating an implicit dependency that is difficult to isolate or substitute during testing.
candidates.title: Direct Singleton Service Access

evidence.description: Creation of an unstructured Task that performs asynchronous work without visible cancellation or lifecycle management.

candidates.explanation: The 'initialize' method creates an unstructured 'Task' to refresh APN registration and request consent. This task has no visible handle, cancellation mechanism, or lifecycle management, meaning it could outlive the operation that initiated it.
candidates.title: Unstructured Concurrency Without Appropriate Lifecycle Management

evidence.description: Creation of an unstructured Task that performs asynchronous work without visible cancellation or lifecycle management.

candidates.explanation: The 'initBraze' method creates an unstructured 'Task' to configure the 'BrazeInAppMessageUI'. This task lacks a mechanism to manage its lifetime or handle cancellation.
candidates.title: Unstructured Concurrency Without Appropriate Lifecycle Management

evidence.description: Writing to the 'notificationAuthorizationStatus' property from an asynchronous context without visible synchronization or actor isolation.

candidates.explanation: The 'retrieveUserCurrentNotificationAuthStatus' method updates the 'notificationAuthorizationStatus' property (which is a mutable instance property) from an asynchronous context without any actor isolation or synchronization mechanism to protect the state.
candidates.title: Improper Isolation of Shared Mutable State
